slug: 2023-10-30 A political economy analysis of strengthening health information system in Tanzania

facts.fact: Kuwawenaruwa et al., from 17 key informant interviews held April-May 2022, state that the government is the custodian of the main HMIS, that identifying needs for its improvement is vested in the Ministry of Health's Monitoring and Evaluation department, and that the government can approve or reject systems not in line with its HMIS investment roadmap.

The paper states that the Health Sector Strategic Plan V (July 2021 - June 2026) and the Digital Health Strategy (July 2019 - June 2024) carry strategic directions for strengthening the HMIS, and that a government HMIS investment roadmap sets out where investment goes; it cites a costing of about USD 74 million for the whole roadmap.

Informants interviewed April-May 2022 said most money for the HMIS is pooled from development partners in the Basket Fund and managed by government, with other donors funding directly or through implementing partners; a private-sector informant urged government to set its own money aside rather than wait for projects. No domestic budget line is stated.

The paper states that DHIS2, used for service utilisation data in a 'partially computerized' HMIS, was piloted and then rolled out to all district councils in 2013; it adds, citing HSSP V (2021), that more than 90% of data flows from health facilities to higher levels through DHIS2. It does not say at which level the data is keyed.

The paper lists GoTHOMIS, introduced 2019, as the patient-level data system for primary health care covering district hospitals, health centres and dispensaries, and a government informant interviewed April-May 2022 said dispensaries and health centres have it in place; no count of facilities is given.

The paper lists AfyaCare, introduced 2018, as the patient-level data system of regional referral hospitals, and a government informant interviewed April-May 2022 said regional hospitals have been implementing it for capturing patient-level data; no count is given.
